GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Lunged at the gate prior to start being effected, missed it a half or three-quarters of a length, Settled Down 4.5 Lengths on fence, railed up to 3 Lengths turning, shifetd Two Wide at 400m, 3 Wide still Held Up until straightening, hooked wider and ran on solidly to the line. (Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) OFF FIRST TIME) # ran on solidly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly badly unbalancing rider. Steadied passing the 1500m when awkwardly placed. Held up from the 400m until passing the 300m. Near the 100m steadied when disappointed for a run and before being shifted out to obtain clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths on fence, Checked 600m, Drifted Back to 4 Lengths Two Wide turning, Dropped Out in straight. (Blinkers AGAIN) # weakened noticeably
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped shortly after the start. Passing the 600m was checked and shifted out abruptly to avoid the heels of a runner which had blundered badly in advance of it.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (ex Scott Singleton) Jumped well landing in front didn't push on Settled Down 2-3 Lengths off the lead between rivals (1000m), tracked speed To The Turn , all Clear top of the Straight called upon, whip Soon After battled away Without threat # sound return
Jumped Ok faced breeze 1 length off, under pressure turn and dropped out # poor
Jumped Well sat box seat 2-3l off, held together turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off, plodded home # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race veterinary examination after contacting the mounting yard  fencing before proceeding to the start and was passed suitable to race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok rolled forward to lead 1 length clear, pushed along a touch turn, Straightened Up half clear, joined passing 200m, joint lead 100m, kept on strong, headed late # led/kept fighting

jumped awkwardly . Rolled fwd & shared lead Two Wide early . Back 1 length to 2nd Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken Four Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & challenged leaders @ 200m. Tried hard but no match in last 150m. Blinkers First Time / winkers off again. # On-pace/tried hard.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly causing the rider to be slightly unbalanced.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well faced breeze 1 length off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, battled on one pace # breeze/leader won
Jumped Well faced breeze half off, pushed along turn, joined in Straightening Up , took narrow lead approaching 200m, joined passing 200m, headed approaching 100m, battled on well # breeze/kept on

Jumped Ok Restrained Took sit Settled Down 4th 1x1 3 Lengths enjoyed good trail with 1st following 2 Lengths behind, out 3 Wide 500 Ridden Along got within 1 Lengths and had its chance but run ended 300 - # battled
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths on fence, shuffled back to 3.5 Lengths rail turning, made a little ground in Straight # never a real threat
